H1901.et: from an unused root akin to (01897)
H1901.def: from an unused root akin to «01897»; properly, a murmur, i.e. complaint:--meditation, musing.

H1902.def: intensive from «01897»; a murmuring sound, i.e. a musical notation (probably similar to the modern affettuoso to indicate solemnity of movement); by implication, a machination:--device, Higgaion, meditation, solemn sound.

H1903.def: of uncertain derivation; perhaps suitable or turning:--directly.

H1904.def: of uncertain (perhaps foreign) derivation; Hagar, the mother of Ishmael:--Hagar.

H1905.def: or (prolonged) Hagris {hag-ree'}; perhaps patronymically from «01904»; a Hagrite or member of a certain Arabian clan:-- Hagarene, Hagarite, Haggeri.

H1907.def: (Aramaic) probably of foreign origin; a vizier:--counsellor.

H1908.def: probably of foreign origin (compare «0111»); Hadad, the name of an idol, and of several kings of Edom:--Hadad.

H1909.def: from «01908» and «05828»; Hadad (is his) help; Hadadezer, a Syrian king:--Hadadezer. Compare «01928».

H1910.def: from «01908» and «07417»; Hadad-Rimmon, a place in Palestine:--Hadad-rimmon.

H1911.def: a primitive root (compare «03034»); to stretch forth the hand:--put.

H1913.def: or Hadoram {had-o-rawm'}; probably of foreign derivation; Hadoram, a son of Joktan, and the tribe descended from him:-- Hadoram.

H1914.def: of uncertain derivation; Hiddai, an Israelite:--Hiddai.

H1915.def: a primitive root (compare «01854»); to crush with the foot:--tread down.

H1916.et: from an unused root meaning to stamp upon
H1916.def: from an unused root meaning to stamp upon; a foot stool:--(foot-)stool.

H1917.et: from a root corresponding to that of (01916)
H1917.def: (Aramaic) from a root corresponding to that of «01916»; something stamped to pieces, i.e. a bit:--piece.

H1920.def: a prim root; to push away or down:--cast away (out), drive, expel, thrust (away).

H1921.def: a primitive root; to swell up (literally or figuratively, active or passive); by implication, to favor or honour, be high or proud:--countenance, crooked place, glorious, honour, put forth.

H1924.def: the same as «01926»; Hadar, an Edomite:--Hadar.

H1925.def: from «01921»; honour; used (figuratively) for the capital city (Jerusalem):--glory.

H1926.def: from «01921»; magnificence, i.e. ornament or splendor:--beauty, comeliness, excellency, glorious, glory, goodly, honour, majesty.

H1928.def: from «01924» and «05828»; Hadar (i.e. Hadad, «01908») is his help; Hadarezer (i.e. Hadadezer, «01909»), a Syrian king:--Hadarezer.

H1929.def: a shortened form of «0162»; ah! expressing grief:--woe worth.

H1931.def: of which the feminine (beyond the Pentateuch) is hiyw {he}; a primitive word, the third person pronoun singular, he (she or it); only expressed when emphatic or without a verb; also (intensively) self, or (especially with the article) the same; sometimes (as demonstrative) this or that; occasionally (instead of copula) as or are:--he, as for her, him(-self), it, the same, she (herself), such, that (...it), these, they, this, those, which (is), who.

H1932.def: (Aramaic) or (feminine) hiyo (Aramaic) {he}; corresponding to «01931»:--X are, it, this.

H1933.def: or havah {haw-vaw'}; a primitive root (compare «0183», «01961») supposed to mean properly, to breathe; to be (in the sense of existence):--be, × have.

H1934.def: (Aramaic) orhavah (Aramaic) {hav-aw'}; corresponding to «01933»; to exist; used in a great variety of applications (especially in connection with other words):--be, become, + behold, + came (to pass), + cease, + cleave, + consider, + do, + give, + have, + judge, + keep, + labour, + mingle (self), + put, + see, + seek, + set, + slay, + take heed, tremble, + walk, + would.

H1935.def: from an unused root; grandeur (i.e. an imposing form and appearance):--beauty, comeliness, excellency, glorious, glory, goodly, honour, majesty.

H1936.def: the same as «01935»; Hod, an Israelite:--Hod.

H1937.def: a form of «01938»; Hodevah (or Hodevjah), an Israelite:--Hodevah.

H1938.def: from «01935» and «03050»; majesty of Jah; Hodavjah, the name of three Israelites:--Hodaviah.

H1939.def: a form of «01938»; Hodajvah, an Israelite:--Hodaiah.

H1940.et: a form for the fem. of (03064)
H1940.def: a form for the feminine of «03064»; a Jewess:--Hodiah.

H1941.def: a form of «01938»; Hodijah, the name of three Israelites:--Hodijah.

H1942.def: from «01933» (in the sense of eagerly coveting and rushing upon; by implication, of falling); desire; also ruin:--calamity, iniquity, mischief, mischievous (thing), naughtiness, naughty, noisome, perverse thing, substance, very wickedness.

H1944.def: of uncertain derivation; Hoham, a Canaanitish king:--Hoham.

H1945.def: a prolonged form of «01930» (akin to «0188»); oh!:--ah, alas, ho, O, woe.

H1946.def: (Aramaic) corresponding to «01981»; to go; causatively, to bring:--bring again, come, go (up).

H1949.def: a primitive root (compare «02000»); to make an uproar, or agitate greatly:--destroy, move, make a noise, put, ring again.

H1950.def: from «02000»; raging; Homam, an Edomitish chieftain:--Homam. Compare «01967».

H1951.def: a primitive root; properly, to be naught, i.e. (figuratively) to be (causatively, act) light:--be ready.

H1952.et: from the same as (01951) in the sense of (0202)
H1952.def: from the same as «01951» in the sense of «0202»; wealth; by implication, enough:--enough, + for nought, riches, substance, wealth.

H1953.def: from «03068» and «08085»; Jehovah has heard; Hoshama, an Israelite:--Hoshama.

H1954.def: from «03467»; deliverer; Hoshea, the name of five Israelites:--Hosea, Hoshea, Oshea.

H1955.def: from «03467» and «03050»; Jah has saved; Hoshajah, the name of two Israelites:--Hoshaiah.

H1956.def: from «03498»; he has caused to remain; Hothir, an Israelite:--Hothir.

H1959.et: from an unused root (meaning to shout)
H1959.def: from an unused root (meaning to shout); acclamation:--shout(-ing).

H1960.def: from the same as «01959»; properly, an acclaim, i.e. a choir of singers:--thanksgiving.

H1961.def: a primitive root (compare «01933»); to exist, i.e. be or become, come to pass (always emphatic, and not a mere copula or auxiliary):--beacon, × altogether, be(-come), accomplished, committed, like), break, cause, come (to pass), do, faint, fall, + follow, happen, × have, last, pertain, quit (one-)self, require, × use.

H1964.et: probably from (03201) (in the sense of capacity)
H1964.def: probably from «03201» (in the sense of capacity); a large public building, such as a palace or temple:--palace, temple.

H1966.def: from «01984» (in the sense of brightness); the morning-star:--lucifer.

H1967.def: another form for «01950»; Hemam, an Idumaean:--Hemam.

H1968.def: probably from «0539»; faithful; Heman, the name of at least two Israelites:--Heman.

H1969.def: probably of Egyptian origin; a hin or liquid measure:--hin.

H1970.def: a primitive root; apparently to injure:--make self strange.

H1972.def: probably denominatively from «01973»; to remove or be remote:--cast far off.

H1973.et: from the primitive form of the article [hal]
H1973.def: from the primitive form of the article (hal); to the distance, i.e. far away; also (of time) thus far:--back, beyond, (hence,-)forward, hitherto, thence,forth, yonder.

H1974.def: from «01984» (in the sense of rejoicing); a celebration of thanksgiving for harvest:--merry, praise.

H1975.def: from «01976»; this or that:--side, that, this.

H1976.def: from the article (see «01973») and «02088»; this very:--this.

H1978.def: from «01980»; a walk, i.e. (by implication) a step:--step.

H1979.def: feminine of «01978»; a walking; by implication, a procession or march, a caravan:--company, going, walk, way.

H1980.def: akin to «03212»; a primitive root; to walk (in a great variety of applications, literally and figuratively):--(all) along, apace, behave (self), come, (on) continually, be conversant, depart, + be eased, enter, exercise (self), + follow, forth, forward, get, go (about, abroad, along, away, forward, on, out, up and down), + greater, grow, be wont to haunt, lead, march, × more and more, move (self), needs, on, pass (away), be at the point, quite, run (along), + send, speedily, spread, still, surely, + tale-bearer, + travel(-ler), walk (abroad, on, to and fro, up and down, to places), wander, wax, (way-)faring man, × be weak, whirl.

H1982.def: from «01980»; properly, a journey, i.e. (by implication) a wayfarer; also a flowing:--X dropped, traveller.

H1983.def: (Aramaic) from «01981»; properly, a journey, i.e. (by implication) toll on goods at a road:--custom.

H1984.def: a primitive root; to be clear (orig. of sound, but usually of color); to shine; hence, to make a show, to boast; and thus to be (clamorously) foolish; to rave; causatively, to celebrate; also to stultify:--(make) boast (self), celebrate, commend, (deal, make), fool(- ish, -ly), glory, give (light), be (make, feign self) mad (against), give in marriage, (sing, be worthy of) praise, rage, renowned, shine.

H1985.def: from «01984»; praising (namely God); Hillel, an Israelite:--Hillel.

H1986.def: a primitive root; to strike down; by implication, to hammer, stamp, conquer, disband:--beat (down), break (down), overcome, smite (with the hammer).

H1987.def: from «01986»; smiter; Helem, the name of two Israelites:--Helem.

H1988.def: from the article (see «01973»); hither:--here, hither(-(to)), thither.

H1990.def: of uncertain derivation; Ham, a region of Palestine:--Ham.

H1991.def: from «01993»; abundance, i.e. wealth:--any of theirs.

H1992.def: or (prolonged) hemmah {haym'-maw}; masculine plural from «01981»; they (only used when emphatic):--it, like, × (how, so) many (soever, more as) they (be), (the) same, × so, × such, their, them, these, they, those, which, who, whom, withal, ye.

H1993.def: a primitive root (compare «01949»); to make a loud sound like Engl. "hum"); by implication, to be in great commotion or tumult, to rage, war, moan, clamor:--clamorous, concourse, cry aloud, be disquieted, loud, mourn, be moved, make a noise, rage, roar, sound, be troubled, make in tumult, tumultuous, be in an uproar.

H1994.def: (Aramaic) or (prolonged) himmown (Aramaic) {him- mone'}; corresponding to «01992»; they:--X are, them, those.

H1995.def: or hamon (Ezek. 5:7) {haw-mone'}; from «01993»; a noise, tumult, crowd; also disquietude, wealth:--abundance, company, many, multitude, multiply, noise, riches, rumbling, sounding, store, tumult.

H1996.def: from «01995» and «01463»; the multitude of Gog; the fanciful name of an emblematic place in Palestine:--Hamogog.

H1997.def: feminine of «01995»; multitude; hamonah, the same as «01996»:--Hamonah.

H1999.et: pass. participle of an unused root
H1999.def: or (too fully) hamuwllah (Jer. ll:l6) {ham- ool-law'}; feminine passive participle of an unused root meaning to rush (as rain with a windy roar); a sound:--speech, tumult.
